import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_6/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_6/training_2.csv"

df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df_source2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source3_6_1 and Source3_6_2 on "movie id"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source2, on="movie id", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source3_6_1.movie title, aggregations avg(Source3_6_2.rating)
df_grouped = df_joined.groupby("movie title", as_index=False)["rating"].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
df_grouped.rename(columns={"movie title": "movie title", "rating": "rating"}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes: 'movie title' as string, 'rating' as float
df_grouped["movie title"] = df_grouped["movie title"].astype(str)
df_grouped["rating"] = df_grouped["rating"].astype(float)

# Save the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_6/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
